tools.name: check_playlist
tools.description: Scores one Spotify playlist for bot and fake-follower risk. Returns the playlist (id, name, curator, followers, tracks, url), botRisk.score from 0 to 100, botRisk.level (low, medium, high or editorial), the warning factors behind the score (follower-to-track ratio, generic naming, sudden follower sp

tools.name: get_curator_contacts
tools.description: Extracts public submission contact channels (emails, Instagram, X/Twitter, TikTok handles, and submission links) from a Spotify playlist description, along with researched curator pitch guidance when available.

tools.name: list_monitors
tools.description: Lists all playlists currently tracked under 24/7 cloud monitoring for the authenticated account, including 24-hour and 7-day follower deltas, anomaly flags, and latest snapshot timestamps. For one playlist's full 31-day snapshot series, call check_playlist with its playlist_id.

tools.name: add_monitor
tools.description: Enrolls a Spotify playlist in automated cloud monitoring for daily follower snapshots, growth trend analysis, and inorganic spike alerts. tools.name: remove_monitor
tools.description: Stops cloud monitoring for one playlist on the signed-in Premium account. The daily follower snapshot, the spike and drop alert emails and the track-removed alert all stop for that playlist on this account, and it disappears from list_monitors. Returns { ok, message, playlistId }. Side effects: dele

tools.description: Describes who SpotCheck thinks the caller is and what they can do right now. tools.name: scan_warning_playlists
tools.description: Scores every Spotify playlist an artist pastes after a distributor flags a track for artificial streaming (the full list from Spotify for Artists). Use it for a batch of up to 50 links; for one playlist, use check_playlist, which also works anonymously. Returns each playlist ranked by bot-risk score

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_account_status" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_playlist, get_curator_contacts, get_account_status · Private data: check_playlist, get_curator_contacts · Public sink: get_account_status · Destructive: remove_monitor.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_playlist, get_curator_contacts, get_account_status · Private data: check_playlist, get_curator_contacts · Public sink: get_account_status · Destructive: remove_monitor

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
